Comment: Very fun and educational web-themed task. Covers basic string manipulation and is doable in any programming language.

Formatting / presentation
* Please study the formatting syntax described on this page: https://www.codingame.com/playgrounds/40701/help-center/statement , and format and present your statement by following the example there.

In addition to what @jonas_melo and @CriusMaximus has mentioned:

Goal
* Please format "key=value" as "[[key]]{{=}}[[value]]".

* Please add:
The parameters must be added to the URL in the order they are given in the input.

Constraints
* Please add a constraint specifying the lower and upper bounds for the lengths of [[base_url]], [[key]] and [[value]]. Please use upper bounds that are closer to the actual cases instead of 100 and 256.

* Please mention that [[baseUrl]] may also contain {{/}}.

Stub generator
* Please replace 100 and 256 with the corresponding bounds specified in the Constraints section.

Thanks.
